bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

# xh

xh is a command-line HTTP client for sending and inspecting HTTP requests. It provides a friendly, concise interface for making HTTP requests and examining responses.

Usage

  xh [OPTIONS] <[METHOD] URL> [REQUEST_ITEM]...

Examples

  # Send a GET request
  xh http://example.org/json

  # Send a POST request with JSON-like key/value items
  xh http://example.org/post name=alice age:=30

  # Read the request body from stdin
  echo "[1,2,3]" | xh post http://example.org/post

Installation

Prebuilt binaries are available on the project's releases page:
https://github.com/ducaale/xh/releases

Alternatively, install using your system's package manager if available (e.g. Homebrew, apt, pacman, etc.).

For more detailed usage run:

  xh help

# xh
[![Version info](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/xh.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/xh)
[![Packaging status](https://repology.org/badge/tiny-repos/xh.svg)](https://repology.org/project/xh/versions)

`xh` is a friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests. It reimplements as much
as possible of [HTTPie's](https://httpie.io/) excellent design, with a focus
on improved performance.

[![asciicast](/assets/xh-demo.gif)](https://asciinema.org/a/475190)

```
iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ducaale/xh/master/install.ps1 | iex
```

| NetBSD                        | pkgsrc     | `pkgin install xh`                         |
| Linux & macOS                 | Nixpkgs    | `nix-env -iA nixpkgs.xh`                   |
| Linux & macOS                 | [Flox]     | `flox install xh`                          |
| Linux & macOS                 | Homebrew   | `brew install xh`                          |
| Linux & macOS                 | [Hermit]   | `hermit install xh`                        |
| macOS                         | MacPorts   | `sudo port install xh`                     |
| Windows                       | Scoop      | `scoop install xh`                         |

### Request Items

`xh` uses [HTTPie's request-item syntax](https://httpie.io/docs/cli/request-items) to set headers, request body, query string, etc.

- `=`/`:=` for setting the request body's JSON or form fields (`=` for strings and `:=` for other JSON types).
- `==` for adding query strings.
- `@` for including files in multipart requests e.g `picture@hello.jpg` or `picture@hello.jpg;type=image/jpeg;filename=goodbye.jpg`.
- `:` for adding or removing headers e.g `connection:keep-alive` or `connection:`.
- `;` for including headers with empty values e.g `header-without-value;`.

An `@` prefix can be used to read a value from a file. For example: `x-api-key:@api-key.txt`.

The request body can also be read from standard input, or from a file using `@filename`.

To construct a complex JSON object, a JSON path can be used as a key e.g `app[container][0][id]=090-5`.
For more information on this syntax, refer to https://httpie.io/docs/cli/nested-json.

### Shorthand form for URLs

Similar to HTTPie, specifying the scheme portion of the request URL is optional, and a leading colon works as shorthand
for localhost. `:8000` is equivalent to `localhost:8000`, and `:/path` is equivalent to `localhost/path`.

URLs can have a leading `://` which allows quickly converting a URL into a valid xh or HTTPie command. For example
`http://httpbin.org/json` becomes `http ://httpbin.org/json`.

```sh
xh :3000/users                 # resolves to http://localh
```

### Making HTTPS requests by default

`xh` will default to HTTPS scheme if the binary name is one of `xhs`, `https`, or `xhttps`. If you have installed `xh`
via a package manager, both `xh` and `xhs` should be available by default. Otherwise, you need to create one like this:

```sh
cd /path/to/xh && ln -s ./xh ./xhs
xh httpbin.org/get  # resolves to http://httpbin.org/get
xhs httpbin.org/get # resolves to https://httpbin.org/get
```

### Strict compatibility mode

If `xh` is invoked as `http` or `https` (by renaming the binary), or if the `XH_HTTPIE_COMPAT_MODE` environment variable is set,
it will run in HTTPie compatibility mode. The only current difference is that `--check-status` is not enabled by default.

## Examples

```sh
# Send a GET request

# Send a POST request with body {"name": "ahmed", "age": 24}
xh httpbin.org/post name=ahmed age:=24

# Send a GET request with querystring id=5&sort=true
xh get httpbin.org/json id==5 sort==true

# Send a GET request and include a header named x-api-key with value 12345
xh get httpbin.org/json x-api-key:12345

# Send a POST request with body read from stdin.
echo "[1, 2, 3]" | xh post httpbin.org/post

# Send a PUT request and pipe the result to less
xh put httpbin.org/put id:=49 age:=25 | less

# Download and save to res.json
xh -d httpbin.org/json -o res.json

# Make a request with a custom user agent
xh httpbin.org/get user-agent:foobar
```

## How xh compares to HTTPie

### Advantages

- Improved startup speed.
- Available as a single statically linked binary that's easy to install and carry around.
- HTTP/2 support.
- Builtin translation to curl commands with the `--curl` flag.
- Short, cheatsheet-style output from `--help`. (For longer output, pass `help`.)

### Disadvantages

- Not all of HTTPie's features are implemented. ([#4](https://github.com/ducaale/xh/issues/4))
- No plugin system.
- General immaturity. HTTPie is old and well-tested.
- Worse documentation.

## Similar or related Projects

- [curlie](https://github.com/rs/curlie) - frontend to cURL that adds the ease of use of httpie
- [httpie-go](https://github.com/nojima/httpie-go) - httpie-like HTTP client written in Go
- [curl2httpie](https://github.com/dcb9/curl2httpie) - convert command arguments between cURL and HTTPie

<output>
xh is a friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests.

It reimplements as much as possible of HTTPie's excellent design, with a focus on improved
performance.

Usage: executable [OPTIONS] <[METHOD] URL> [REQUEST_ITEM]...

Arguments:
  <[METHOD] URL>
          The request URL, preceded by an optional HTTP method.
          
          If the method is omitted, it will default to GET, or to POST if the request contains a
          body.
          
          The URL scheme defaults to "http://" normally, or "https://" if the program is invoked as
          "xhs".
          
          A leading colon works as shorthand for localhost. ":8000" is equivalent to
          "localhost:8000", and ":/path" is equivalent to "localhost/path".

  [REQUEST_ITEM]...
          Optional key-value pairs to be included in the request.
          
          The separator is used to determine the type:
          
              key==value
                  Add a query string to the URL.
          
              key=value
                  Add a JSON property (--json) or form field (--form) to the request body.
          
              key:=value
                  Add a field with a literal JSON value to the request body.
          
                  Example: "numbers:=[1,2,3] enabled:=true"
          
              key@filename
                  Upload a file (requires --form or --multipart).
          
                  To set the filename and mimetype, ";type=" and ";filename=" can be used
                  respectively.
          
                  Example: "pfp@ra.jpg;type=image/jpeg;filename=profile.jpg"
          
              @filename
                  Use a file as the request body.
          
              header:value
                  Add a header, e.g. "user-agent:foobar"
          
              header:
                  Unset a header, e.g. "connection:"
          
              header;
                  Add a header with an empty value.
          
          An "@" prefix can be used to read a value from a file. For example:
          "x-api-key:@api-key.txt".
          
          A backslash can be used to escape special characters, e.g. "weird\:key=value".
          
          To construct a complex JSON object, the REQUEST_ITEM's key can be set to a JSON path
          instead of a field name. For more information on this syntax, refer to
          https://httpie.io/docs/cli/nested-json.

Options:
  -j, --json
          (default) Serialize data items from the command line as a JSON object.
          
          Overrides both --form and --multipart.

  -f, --form
          Serialize data items from the command line as form fields.
          
          Overrides both --json and --multipart.

      --multipart
          Like --form, but force a multipart/form-data request even without files.
          
          Overrides both --json and --form.

      --raw <RAW>
          Pass raw request data without extra processing

      --pretty <STYLE>

OUT 'curl http://example.com/\n'

for a in cases:

import subprocess,os
for pretty in ['all','colors','format','none']:
 for style in ['', 'monokai','solarized','fruity','auto']:
  a=['./executable','-I','--offline','--pretty='+pretty]+(['--style='+style] if style else [])+['ex.com','z=hi','b:=true','n:=null','a:=[1,2]']
  p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True)
  print(pretty,style,'OUT',repr(p.stdout),'ERR',repr(p.stderr))
  if pretty in ['format','none']:break
print('---RAW FORMAT---')
for body in ['{}','[]','1','true','null','"abc"','{"a":1}\n','{"x":1,"x":2}', '[ 1.00, 1e10, -0 ]', '{"z":1}\n{"a":2}', '{invalid}', '\n', '{"a":', ' ["\\u0041", "\\/", "\\u00e9"]', '{"a":1}\ninvalid']:
 p=subprocess.run(['./executable','-I','--offline','--pretty=format','-pB','--raw='+body,'ex.com'],capture_output=True)
 print(repr(body),'OUT',repr(p.stdout),'ERR',repr(p.stderr))
for opt in ['json.indent:0','json.indent:1','json.format:false','headers.sort:false','json.indent:100','json.indent:65536','json.indent:2,','', 'json.indent:2,json.indent:3', 'json.indent: 2']:
 p=subprocess.run(['./executable','-I','--offline','--pretty=format','-pB','--format-options='+opt,'ex.com','a=1'],capture_output=True)
 print(opt,'RC',p.returncode,'OUT',repr(p.stdout[:250]),'ERR',repr(p.stderr))
PY

"""HTTP Digest authentication response generation."""
import hashlib
import secrets
import re
from common import fail


def make_digest(request, raw_auth, challenge):
    contents = challenge[6:] if challenge.startswith('Digest') else challenge
    values = {}
    for match in re.finditer(r'(?:^|,)\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"|([^,\s]*))', contents):
        value = match[2] if match[2] is not None else match[3]
        values[match[1].lower()] = re.sub(r'\\(.)',r'\1', value)
    for key in ('realm','nonce'):
        if key not in values:
            fail('Missing "' + key + '" in header: ' + contents)
    user, _, password = raw_auth.partition(':')
    realm, nonce = values['realm'], values['nonce']
    algorithm = values.get('algorithm','MD5')
    sess = algorithm.lower().endswith('-sess')
    name = algorithm[:-5] if sess else algorithm
    hash_name = {'md5':'md5','sha-256':'sha256','sha-512-256':'sha512_256'}.get(name.lower())
    if hash_name is None:
        fail('Unsupported algorithm: ' + algorithm)
    def h(x):
        if isinstance(x,str): x=x.encode('utf-8')
        return hashlib.new(hash_name,x).hexdigest()
    cnonce = secrets.token_hex(15)
    qops = [v.strip() for v in values.get('qop','').split(',') if v.strip()]
    qop = 'auth' if 'auth' in qops else 'auth-int' if 'auth-int' in qops else None
    if qops and qop is None:
        fail('Unsupported qop: ' + values['qop'])
    ha1 = h(user+':'+realm+':'+password)
    if sess: ha1 = h(ha1+':'+nonce+':'+cnonce)
    uri = request.url.resource()
    ha2 = h(request.method+':'+uri+(':'+h(request.body.data or b'') if qop == 'auth-int' else ''))
    nc = '00000001'
    response = h(ha1+':'+nonce+':'+(nc+':'+cnonce+':'+qop+':' if qop else '')+ha2)
    def quote(s):return '"'+s.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')+'"'
    fields = [('username',quote(user)),('realm',quote(realm)),('nonce',quote(nonce)),('uri',quote(uri))]
    if qop:
        fields.extend([('qop',qop),('nc',nc),('cnonce',quote(cnonce))])
    fields.append(('response',quote(response)))
    if 'opaque' in values:fields.append(('opaque',quote(values['opaque'])))
    fields.append(('algorithm',algorithm))
    return ('Digest ' + ', '.join(k+'='+v for k,v in fields)).encode('utf-8')

"""HTTP Digest authentication response generation."""
import hashlib
import secrets
import re
from common import fail


def make_digest(request, raw_auth, challenge):
    contents = challenge[6:] if challenge.startswith('Digest') else challenge
    values = {}
    for match in re.finditer(r'(?:^|,)\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"|([^,\s]*))', contents):
        value = match[2] if match[2] is not None else match[3]
        values[match[1].lower()] = re.sub(r'\\(.)',r'\1', value)
    for key in ('realm','nonce'):
        if key not in values:
            fail('Missing "' + key + '" in header: ' + contents)
    user, _, password = raw_auth.partition(':')
    realm, nonce = values['realm'], values['nonce']
    algorithm = values.get('algorithm','MD5')
    sess = algorithm.lower().endswith('-sess')
    name = algorithm[:-5] if sess else algorithm
    hash_name = {'md5':'md5','sha-256':'sha256','sha-512-256':'sha512_256'}.get(name.lower())
    if hash_name is None:
        fail('Unsupported algorithm: ' + algorithm)
    def h(x):
        if isinstance(x,str): x=x.encode('utf-8')
        return hashlib.new(hash_name,x).hexdigest()
    cnonce = secrets.token_hex(15)
    qops = [v.strip() for v in values.get('qop','').split(',') if v.strip()]
    qop = 'auth' if 'auth' in qops else 'auth-int' if 'auth-int' in qops else None
    if qops and qop is None:
        fail('Unsupported qop: ' + values['qop'])
    ha1 = h(user+':'+realm+':'+password)
    if sess: ha1 = h(ha1+':'+nonce+':'+cnonce)
    uri = request.url.resource()
    ha2 = h(request.method+':'+uri+(':'+h(request.body.data or b'') if qop == 'auth-int' else ''))
    nc = '00000001'
    response = h(ha1+':'+nonce+':'+(nc+':'+cnonce+':'+qop+':' if qop else '')+ha2)
    def quote(s):return '"'+s.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')+'"'
    fields = [('username',quote(user)),('realm',quote(realm)),('nonce',quote(nonce)),('uri',quote(uri))]
    if qop:
        fields.extend([('qop',qop),('nc',nc),('cnonce',quote(cnonce))])
    fields.append(('response',quote(response)))
    if 'opaque' in values:fields.append(('opaque',quote(values['opaque'])))
    fields.append(('algorithm',algorithm))
    return ('Digest ' + ', '.join(k+'='+v for k,v in fields)).encode('utf-8')

"""Regression tests for the public command line and HTTP interface.

All HTTP tests use an in-process local fixture, and need no network access.
Build first with ./compile.sh, then run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
"""
import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import http.server
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
import zlib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PROGRAM = Path(os.environ.get('XH_EXECUTABLE', ROOT / 'executable')).resolve()


class ClientTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.directory = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.lower() not in ('http_proxy','https_proxy','all_proxy','no_proxy')}
        self.env.update(XH_CONFIG_DIR=str(self.directory / 'config'), NETRC=str(self.directory / 'absent-netrc'))
        self.env.pop('XH_HTTPIE_COMPAT_MODE',None)
        self.env.pop('NO_COLOR',None)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def invoke(self, *args, data=b'', env=None):
        values = dict(self.env)
        if env: values.update(env)
        return subprocess.run([str(PROGRAM), *args], input=data, capture_output=True, env=values, timeout=5)

    def test_version(self):
        p = self.invoke('--version')
        self.assertEqual((p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr),(0,b'xh 0.25.3\n-native-tls +rustls\n',b''))

    def test_offline_get(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','example.org')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout, b'GET / HTTP/1.1\nAccept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd\nUser-Agent: xh/0.25.3\nConnection: keep-alive\nAccept: */*\nHost: example.org\n\n')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode,0)

    def test_nested_json(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pB','example.org','app[users][0][name]=Ada','app[users][1][active]:=true','count:=2')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{"app":{"users":[{"name":"Ada"},{"active":true}]},"count":2}\n\n')
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr,b'')

    def test_json_format(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pB','--pretty=format','--format-options=json.indent:2','example.org','z=one','a:=[1,2]')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{\n  "z": "one",\n  "a": [\n    1,\n    2\n  ]\n}\n\n\n\n')

    def test_form_encoding(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pB','-f','example.org','a=hello world','a=one&two','~=~')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'a=hello+world&a=one%26two&%7E=%7E\n\n')

    def test_stdin(self):
        p = self.invoke('--offline','-pB','example.org',data=b'[1,2,3]')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'[1,2,3]\n\n')
        p = self.invoke('--offline','example.org','x=y')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode,1)
        self.assertIn(b'--ignore-stdin',p.stderr)

    def test_duplicate_headers_and_removal(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pH','example.org','X-Test:first','x-test:second','User-Agent:')
        self.assertIn(b'X-Test: first\nX-Test: second\n',p.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn(b'User-Agent:',p.stdout)

    def test_curl(self):
        p = self.invoke('--curl','--auth=u:p','example.org/path','q==hello world','name=Ada','n:=2')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b"curl 'http://example.org/path?q=hello+world' --basic -u u:p -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, */*;q=0.5' -d '{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"n\":2}'\n")
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr,b'')

    def test_curl_ipv6(self):
        p = self.invoke('--curl-long','--headers','http://[::1]:8080/')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b"curl --head --request GET --globoff 'http://[::1]:8080/'\n")

    def test_json_error(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','example.org','x:=[1,]')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode,2)
        self.assertIn(b'trailing comma at line 1 column 4',p.stderr)
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','example.org','x:=false','x[a]=b')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode,1)
        self.assertIn(b"type of 'bool'",p.stderr)

    def test_file_values_and_binary(self):
        value = self.directory / 'value.txt'
        value.write_text('hello\n')
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pB','example.org','value=@'+str(value))
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{"value":"hello\\n"}\n\n')
        value.write_bytes(b'\0abc')
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','-pB','example.org','@'+str(value))
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'+-----------------------------------------+\n| NOTE: binary data not shown in terminal |\n+-----------------------------------------+\n\n\n')

    def test_config(self):
        config = self.directory / 'config'
        config.mkdir()
        (config/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'default_options':['-I','--offline','--pretty=format','-pB']}))
        p = self.invoke('example.org','x=y')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{\n    "x": "y"\n}\n\n\n\n')
        p = self.invoke('--no-pretty','example.org','x=y')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{"x":"y"}\n\n')

    def test_session(self):
        session = self.directory / 'session.json'
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','--session='+str(session),'example.org','X-Test:hello','--auth=u:p')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode,0)
        content = json.loads(session.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(content['auth'],{'type':'basic','raw_auth':'u:p'})
        self.assertEqual(content['headers'],[{'name':'x-test','value':'hello'}])
        p = self.invoke('-I','--offline','--session-read-only='+str(session),'example.org')
        self.assertIn(b'X-Test: hello\n',p.stdout)
        self.assertIn(b'Authorization: Basic dTpw\n',p.stdout)


class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    def log_message(self,*args):
        pass

    def do_GET(self):
        self.exchange()
    do_POST = do_GET
    do_PUT = do_GET
    do_HEAD = do_GET

    def exchange(self):
        data = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
        if self.headers.get('Content-Encoding') == 'deflate':
            data = zlib.decompress(data)
        status = 200
        headers = []
        body = b'{"z":1,"a":2}'
        if self.path == '/echo':
            body = json.dumps({'method':self.command,'data':data.decode('utf-8'),'auth':self.headers.get('Authorization')},separators=(',',':')).encode()
        elif self.path == '/redirect':
            status = 302
            headers = [('Location','/json')]
            body = b'redirect'
        elif self.path == '/404':
            status = 404
            body = b'not found'
        elif self.path == '/gzip':
            body = gzip.compress(body,mtime=0)
            headers = [('Content-Encoding','gzip')]
        elif self.path == '/cookie':
            headers = [('Set-Cookie','sid=one; Path=/')]
        elif self.path == '/digest':
            auth = self.headers.get('Authorization')
            if not auth:
                status = 401
                headers = [('WWW-Authenticate','Digest realm="test", nonce="nonce", qop="auth", algorithm=MD5')]
            else:
                fields = dict((m[1],m[2] or m[3]) for m in re.finditer(r'(\w+)=(?:"([^"]*)"|([^, ]+))',auth))
                h = lambda s:hashlib.md5(s.encode()).hexdigest()
                wanted = h(h('user:test:pass')+':nonce:'+fields['nc']+':'+fields['cnonce']+':auth:'+h('GET:/digest'))
                if fields['response'] != wanted: status = 403
        elif self.path == '/resume':
            body = b'abcdefghij'
            if self.headers.get('Range'):
                offset = int(self.headers['Range'][6:-1])
                body = body[offset:]
                status = 206
                headers = [('Content-Range',f'bytes {offset}-9/10')]
        self.send_response_only(status)
        for k,v in headers:self.send_header(k,v)
        self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        if self.path == '/slow':time.sleep(.15)
        if self.command != 'HEAD':
            try:self.wfile.write(body)
            except OSError:pass


class QuietServer(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def handle_error(self,*args):pass


class HttpTest(ClientTest):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.server = QuietServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
        cls.url = 'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(cls.server.server_port)
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever,daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.thread.join()

    def test_response(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I',self.url+'/json')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{"z":1,"a":2}')
        p = self.invoke('-I','--pretty=format',self.url+'/json')
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout,b'{\n    "z": 1,\n    "a": 2\n}\n\n')

    def test_post_and_compression(self):
        p = self.invoke('-I','-xx','-a','user:pass',self.url+'/echo','x=y')
        result = json.loads(p.stdout)

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    do_PUT = do_GET
    do_HEAD = do_GET

    def exchange(self):
        data = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
        if self.headers.get('Content-Encoding') == 'deflate':
            data = zlib.decompress(data)
        status = 200
        headers = []
        body = b'{"z":1,"a":2}'
        if self.path == '/echo':
            body = json.dumps({'method':self.command,'data':data.decode('utf-8'),'auth':self.headers.get('Authorization')},separators=(',',':')).encode()
        elif self.path == '/redirect':
            status = 302
            headers = [('Location','/json')]
            body = b'redirect'
        elif self.path == '/404':
            status = 404
            body = b'not found'
        elif self.path == '/gzip':
            body = gzip.compress(body,mtime=0)
            headers = [('Content-Encoding','gzip')]
        elif self.path == '/cookie':
            headers = [('Set-Cookie','sid=one; Path=/')]
        elif self.path == '/digest':
            auth = self.headers.get('Authorization')
            if not auth:
                status = 401
                headers = [('WWW-Authenticate','Digest realm="test", nonce="nonce", qop="auth", algorithm=MD5')]
            else:
                fields = dict((m[1],m[2] or m[3]) for m in re.finditer(r'(\w+)=(?:"([^"]*)"|([^, ]+))',auth))
                h = lambda s:hashlib.md5(s.encode()).hexdigest()
                wanted = h(h('user:test:pass')+':nonce:'+fields['nc']+':'+fields['cnonce']+':auth:'+h('GET:/digest'))
                if fields['response'] != wanted: status = 403
        elif self.path == '/resume':
            body = b'abcdefghij'
            if self.headers.get('Range'):
                offset = int(self.headers['Range'][6:-1])
                body = body[offset:]
                status = 206
                headers = [('Content-Range',f'bytes {offset}-9/10')]
        self.send_response_only(status)

        self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
